import pandas as pd
import numpy as np

def solve(prices, split_factors):
    # Adjust prices for splits
    adjusted_prices = prices * split_factors.cumprod()
    
    # Initialize weights DataFrame with zeros
    weights = pd.DataFrame(0.0, index=prices.index, columns=prices.columns)
    
    # Define the window sizes
    fast_window = 5
    slow_window = 20
    
    # Iterate over the DataFrame starting from the 20th row
    for i in range(slow_window, len(adjusted_prices)):
        # Calculate the mean of the last 5 and last 20 adjusted closes
        mean_fast = adjusted_prices.iloc[i-fast_window:i].mean()
        mean_slow = adjusted_prices.iloc[i-slow_window:i].mean()
        
        # Compute the signal
        signal = (mean_fast - mean_slow).apply(np.sign)
        
        # Assign weights
        weights.iloc[i] = signal / 4
    
    return weights
